periods.time: vol-11 ch-002 immediately after the final

name.zh: 决赛后掌声与未来威胁的确认
name.en: Postmatch applause and confirmation of future threats

periods.location: Osaka Bay Dome stands and exit routes
periods.summary: After Ikki and Stella are carried away unconscious, spectators applaud both victor and loser. Sara, Rinna and Charlotte react from the Akatsuki side, while Edelweiss tells Tsukikage that Ikki has stepped outside the world's causal fate and that he and Stella may oppose the despair-filled future Tsukikage has foreseen. She also notes that other Majin/Desperado-class figures in the venue will recognize the birth of a new future.
periods.cause: Ikki's impossible magic increase and victory over Stella reveal a new world-level factor.
periods.outcome: The tournament's conclusion becomes a signpost for international and supernatural conflicts beyond Japan's student circuit.
periods.significance: Confirms the world-building implication of Ikki's awakening: he may help alter the future Tsukikage fears.
